baselines.majority: predict the training-fold majority class; probabilities = training class priors
baselines.momentum: LONG if ret_bps_60s > 0, SHORT if < 0, NO_TRADE if == 0 (causal trailing 60 s return)
baselines.prior_probabilities: log-loss/Brier reference only: training-fold class priors
baselines.stratified_random: sample classes from the training priors with seed 7; probabilities = training priors

block_bootstrap.basis: 10 x the label horizon (60 s); the autocorrelation of the label series is reported as a check, not used to choose the block

calibration.fit_data: the LAST 20% (by time) of each fold's TRAINING rows; the model is fit on the first 80% minus an 1,800 s embargo and a 60 s+latency purge; the SAME 80%-model is reported uncalibrated and calibrated
calibration.method: temperature scaling (single parameter T on log-probabilities, NLL-minimised)
calibration.validation_leakage: none: validation rows never enter model, preprocessing, regime thresholds or calibrator

controls.purpose: detect calendar/feed/cost proxies: same pipeline, LightGBM with the leading hyperparameters

selectivity_research_preregistered.report: coverage and macro-F1 / accuracy among accepted rows (descriptive calibration/selectivity study only)

feature_configs.CONDITIONAL: 108 ALLOWED + 8 session running aggregates, each masked to NaN unless session_so_far_complete == 1
feature_configs.REGIME: 108 ALLOWED + spread_regime_code + volatility_regime_code recomputed per fold from reference quantiles fitted on that fold's TRAINING rows only (calibrate_reference_quantiles; spread (0.95, 0.995), volatility (0.20, 0.80, 0.98), per session code)

final_holdout: LOCKED: not read, not evaluated, not inspected in this phase
folds: the five frozen expanding folds F1..F5 (folds_v1.json), purge/embargo as frozen

logistic.scale: median/IQR (CausalScaler fit on the training block)
logistic.winsorize: clip to training-block 0.1% / 99.9% quantiles per feature

probes.drift: population stability index of every feature, training block vs validation block (10 training-quantile bins)
probes.feed_boundary: fold F5 validation split into pre (2026-08-24..09-04) and post (2026-09-07..09-11) rows
probes.importance: built-in + permutation importance (macro-F1 and log-loss deltas, 3 repeats, <=40,000 validation rows) for the leading logistic and leading LightGBM candidates; stability = Spearman rank correlation between folds
probes.month_identifiability: predict the calendar month from CORE features with day-grouped 5-fold CV (descriptive)

sampling.note: 1-s rows are strongly autocorrelated; a 30 s grid keeps ~1/30 of rows with 50% overlap between neighbouring 60 s labels. Dependence is handled by block bootstrap and a non-overlapping 60 s robustness evaluation.
sampling.rule: bar ends with (ts//1000) % 30 == 0, row_valid == 1, label status OK

search_policy: this grid is final; it is never expanded after seeing results (a larger search needs a new protocol version)

selection_rule.choice: highest S among gate-passers; if candidates are within 0.005 of the best S, prefer the simpler: logistic < LightGBM, CORE < CONDITIONAL < REGIME, fewer trees, fewer leaves, larger C-regularisation

gates (all must hold, evaluated on calib.G1_beats_baselines: mean-over-scenarios fold macro-F1 > the best naive baseline's, in >= 4 of 5 folds
gates (all must hold, evaluated on calib.G2_probabilistic_skill: fold log-loss < training-prior log-loss in >= 4 of 5 folds
gates (all must hold, evaluated on calib.G3_all_classes_predicted: mean validation recall of every class >= 0.05
gates (all must hold, evaluated on calib.G4_no_proxy_flag: no leakage/proxy flag from the rule below

selection_rule.no_gate_passer: report NO CANDIDATE; the verdict becomes NO RELIABLE SIGNAL DETECTED
selection_rule.proxy_flag: set if (a) a control model (session_only or spread_only) reaches >= 80% of the candidate's mean macro-F1 lift over the best baseline in the same scenario, or (b) the session + spread feature groups carry >= 50% of the candidate's total group-permutation log-loss increase
selection_rule.score: S = M - D - E; M = mean over scenarios and folds of macro-F1; D = mean over scenarios of the SD over folds of macro-F1; E = mean over scenarios and folds of top-label ECE (calibrated)
selection_rule.unit: candidate = (feature_config, model_family, hyperparameters); each trained separately for C0, C1 and C2 labels

third_family: NOT used: no justification beyond logistic + gradient boosting for a first causal-signal test

verdict_rule.PREDICTIVE SIGNAL DETECTED: for the selected candidate in ALL THREE scenarios: lower 95% CI of delta macro-F1 vs the best baseline > 0 and point >= 0.02; lower 95% CI of the log-loss improvement over the prior > 0 and point >= 0.005; the candidate beats the best baseline in >= 4 of 5 folds per scenario; no proxy flag
verdict_rule.WEAK/UNSTABLE SIGNAL: the pooled point estimates beat the best baseline (macro-F1 and log loss) in >= 2 of 3 scenarios but at least one 'DETECTED' criterion fails
verdict_rule.economic_claims: none: predictive classification performance only; costs C1/C2 are hypothetical; profitability is UNVERIFIED
verdict_rule.holdout_evaluation_justified: only for PREDICTIVE SIGNAL DETECTED; for WEAK/UNSTABLE the pre-registered answer is NO (any evaluation would need an explicit decision by the owner knowing it is not supported); for NO RELIABLE SIGNAL the answer is NO
verdict_rule.paired_block_bootstrap: blocks of 600 s resampled within each fold, B=1000, seed 7, pooled predictions; paired with the best baseline
